messages:
elaine: SLO burn: api-gateway 5xx rate at ~4.8% over 15m (alerting on error_budget > 3%). Support just escalated — multiple customers reporting model timeouts and 502/504s. See ticket #1892 from Payments team.

matt: seeing the same on the dashboard. Latency p95 jumped from 180ms to ~1.2s. A lot of 504s upstream.

rachel: deploy-bot shows a config rollout to gateway-proxy at 2027-05-03T11:42Z (hash c1f9a). Could be related.

deploy-bot: rollout completed for gateway-proxy:c1f9a -> stable at 2027-05-03T11:42Z.

samir: running a quick log query (Loki) for 5xx from gateway over last 20m:
```
{job="gateway"} |= "status=5" | json | count_over_time({job="gateway"}[20m])
```
results show spike aligned with that rollout timestamp.

nora: tracer sampling looks lower for some services — Jaeger sampling rate for `api-gateway` dropped to 0.05 around 11:40Z. That explains tracing gaps for many 5xx requests (can't see spans to upstream model-serving).

matt: for repro, I can trigger the timeout locally with a curl that mimics the clients:
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPRO_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-redwood", "input":"repeat: 5000 tokens"}' \
  --max-time 40
```
that produces a 504 in ~38s on staging with the same gateway config.

elaine: two fronts: (1) immediate mitigation to stop SLO burn and (2) root cause — whether rollout changed timeouts or changed proxy pooling.

rachel: rolling gateway-proxy config back to previous revision now (c1f8d). Will monitor.

ops-bot: rollback started for gateway-proxy -> target c1f8d.

samir: while rollback runs, I recommend temporarily increasing the upstream timeout to 90s and scaling model-serving pool +1 replica to absorb bursts. I'll run the autoscale override.

matt: updated HPA override: model-serving-prod minReplicas=6 -> 8 (temporary).

nora: enabling extra tracing sampling to 0.25 for api-gateway and model-serving for 30m to capture spans for any remaining 5xxs.

support-bot: customer ticket #1892 updated: "We observed 502/504s starting ~11:43Z; engineering investigating. Will follow up in 30m."

rachel: rollback finished at 11:55Z. Early signs: 5xx rate dropping to ~1.2% over last 5m. p95 latency trending down.

samir: confirmed that the rollout changed the `upstream_keepalive` and `proxy_read_timeout` defaults — our config baked a lower keepalive and shorter read timeout. That exposed model-serving tail latency and reduced connection reuse, increasing upstream connection churn and 5xx.

elaine: root cause = config change in gateway-proxy that tightened upstream timeouts + unintended keepalive behavior. Contrib factors: lower trace sampling hid visibility, and autoscale didn't react quickly enough for burst.

matt: followups (action items):
- revert config change from rollout permanently until proper canary + perf tests exist (rachel)
- add unit/integration test in deploy pipeline that verifies upstream keepalive & timeout invariants (eng-platform)
- increase short-term tracing sampling window during high-error-rate windows (observability)
- add synthetic p95/p99 probes that hit model-serving behind the gateway from multiple regions (sre/qa)
- support to batch customers affected for remediation/billing review if needed (support)

rachel: creating PR to lock down the default gateway timeouts and add a deploy check: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/pulls/724 (action rachel).

nora: logging note — some 5xx logs lack request_id due to the proxy dropping X-Request-Id header on error. I'll add a fallback to inject a correlation id in gateway error path so logs/traces can be stitched.

support-bot: ticket #1892 -> engineering notes linked. Notifying affected customers with ETA 60m.

elaine: SLO burn cleared to ~1% over last 10m. Closing alert but keeping watches for 2h. Great triage — documenting postmortem and will open an incident writeup under postmortems/ if anything else emerges.

samir: I captured a compact query for postmortem:
```
-- ClickHouse
SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) as minute, countIf(status >= 500) as errs, count() as total
FROM http_requests
WHERE service='api-gateway' AND event_time >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute
```
useful to show the error spike window and correlate with deploy timestamp.

matt: leaving watch on dashboards. If it creeps back up, I'll open an incident channel.

elaine: assigning followups: rachel (PR + deploy block), nora (logging fallback), samir (autoscale tuning + probe), matt (dashboards + alert tuning), support (customer comms). We'll reconvene 24h for postmortem notes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
